h1: A social media content plan you can actually follow
overview: We plan your month of posts so you always know what to share. After looking at your products, buyers and what is already working, we map content pillars, post ideas, formats and the best days to publish. Each idea comes with a short note on the angle and the call to action. You get the plan in a shared sheet, ready for you or a freelancer to produce.

faq: You get angles and hook lines for every idea, plus caption starters on Standard and Premium. Full caption writing for every post is a separate service you can request.
Is this just a list of generic ideas?
No. We base the plan on your products, your buyers' questions and what your competitors post, so ideas are specific to your business, not generic tips.
Can I use the plan with a freelancer or team?
Yes. It is a simple sheet with clear notes for each post, so a designer, editor or social media helper can start straight away without long meetings.
What if I have no time to film or design?
We plan around what you can actually do, such as photos from your phone or simple text posts. You can order post design or video edits as well to produce the ideas.
